description: This source file defines data structures, functions, and methods for loading, validating, and processing configuration schemas for an agent package, including parsing a YAML configuration file, validating its contents, and providing default values.

classes.name: ConfigurationField
classes.description: Represents a single configuration field with attributes like name, type, default value, validation regex, options, and min/max constraints.

classes.name: ConfigurationSchema
classes.description: Encapsulates required and optional configuration fields forming the schema for configuration validation.

classes.name: AgentFieldPackageConfig
classes.description: Main configuration structure for agent package details including name, version, description, dependencies, capabilities, runtime, environment, user schema, and metadata.

classes.name: AgentNodeConfig
classes.description: Configuration for agent node, including node ID and default port.

classes.name: DependenciesConfig
classes.description: Lists dependencies such as Python packages.

classes.name: CapabilitiesConfig
classes.description: Lists reasoners and skills capabilities with names and descriptions.

classes.name: CapabilityItem
classes.description: Represents a single capability with name and description.

classes.name: RuntimeConfig
classes.description: Runtime settings such as auto port, heartbeat interval, and dev mode.

classes.name: MetadataConfig
classes.description: Metadata information including creation time, SDK version, language, and platform.

methods.name: LoadAgentFieldPackageConfig
methods.description: Loads and parses the 'agentfield-package.yaml' file from a specified directory, returning the parsed configuration.

methods.name: validateConfigurationSchema
methods.description: Validates the given configuration schema structure for correctness of fields, types, and regex patterns.

methods.name: validateConfigurationField
methods.description: Validates individual configuration fields, including name, description, type, options, validation regex, and default value.

methods.name: validateFieldValue
methods.description: Validates a specific value against a configuration field's rules, including type, range, options, and regex pattern.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates a full configuration map against the provided schema, ensuring required fields are present and values are valid.

methods.name: GetConfigurationWithDefaults
methods.description: Returns a configuration map with default values applied where not provided.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Helper function to check if a string slice contains a specific string.
